extraction.description: The screenshot shows UiPath Studio Web with an activity picker dialog open over the workflow designer. The picker is searching for "send email" and the Gmail "Send Email" connector activity is highlighted. In the right properties panel, the task action is set to "Execute connector activity" and the required "Select activity" field is active.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the highlighted "Send Email" result for Gmail in the activity picker. This selects the Gmail Send Email connector activity for the "Select activity" field while the Action remains set to "Execute connector activity".
